title: Visiting /vtec redirects to /vtec/fleet
preconditions: Logged in as a user with vtec.read
expectedResult: The browser is redirected to /vtec/fleet on mount, matching the /vciso module's own no-content-index pattern.

title: A user without vtec.read sees the PermissionGate fallback on every /vtec/* route, never page content
preconditions: A user with no vtec.* permissions
expectedResult: All three routes show the Access Denied fallback; none render fleet/connector data.

title: Status badges never show a fabricated 'degraded' state
description: ConnectorStatusEnum is only pending|active|offline|revoked — there is no 'degraded' value anywhere in the real schema, only in earlier mockup prose.
preconditions: Connectors in each of the 4 real statuses
steps: View the fleet dashboard with connectors in pending/active/offline/revoked states
expectedResult: Exactly those 4 states render as Pending/Online/Offline/Revoked; no 'Degraded' badge or summary tile appears anywhere.

title: The cert expiry countdown reflects the real certExpiresAt field, not a placeholder
preconditions: A registered connector with a known certExpiresAt
steps: Compare the displayed countdown against the raw GET /connectors/<id>/status response
expectedResult: The countdown's underlying timestamp matches certExpiresAt exactly; it is not a fixed/hardcoded duration.

title: config.example.yaml's documented defaults match Config Manager's real Load() defaults
steps: Diff every default value in config.example.yaml's comments against the literal v.SetDefault(...) calls in Load()
expectedResult: No documented default has drifted from the real code default.

title: A newly-registered connector appears on the fleet dashboard without a manual page refresh
preconditions: The fleet dashboard open in a browser tab
steps: Register a fresh connector via a different session/terminal while the fleet tab stays open
Wait up to the page's auto-refresh interval
expectedResult: The new connector's row appears without the operator reloading the page.
